environment: Actual local Laravel HTTP server; private temporary SQLite/key/storage. Synthetic QA/native order records exercised through real protocol, proof and readout services; NO genuine provider acceptance or observed customer outcomes. Fixed-readout example is synthetic code/serialization evidence only.

definitions.causal_readout: A frozen opt-in pre-registered native-evidence readout estimates positive EUR captured-purchase conversion within30 days, including purchases later refunded. Its protocol, equal follow-up, source reconciliation, consent and sample-ratio gates must pass. Current arms and conversion_comparison remain exploratory net-paid summaries. No automatic rollout.
definitions.orders: Only signed-provider order data carrying a valid assignment and confirmed paid inside its 30-day window. Redirects and clicks are not payments.
definitions.limitations: Consented assigned visitors only; provider/storefront must propagate assignment_token. Missing tokens remain unattributed. Comparison is exploratory: live propagation, equal follow-up and a fixed analysis plan are unverified. No causal uplift or rollout winner claimed.
definitions.comparison: Variant minus control conversion probability (multiply by 100 for percentage points); relative_change is a fraction of control, null at zero baseline. All assignments remain in denominators, including revoked/expired assignments; distinct visitors with qualifying net-paid EUR orders are successes. At least ten successes and failures per arm are required for the unadjusted two-sided z-test and 95% Wald interval. Repeated looks and multiple experiments are not adjusted. Refunds and late callbacks can change results.
